# vulnetix_detection_rule_feed (Data Source)

One detection rule feed and its entries, looked up by `uuid` or `name`. Point an IDS, IPS, WAF or SIEM at `manifest_url` to consume it. Feeds need a Pro plan or higher.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vulnetix_detection_rule_feed" "suricata" {
  name = "edge-ips"
}

# Point the sensor at the published manifest.
output "suricata_manifest" {
  value = data.vulnetix_detection_rule_feed.suricata.manifest_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The feed's name. Set this or `uuid`; it must match exactly one feed.
- `uuid` (String) The feed's id. Set this or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) When the feed was created, in Unix milliseconds.
- `description` (String) The feed's description.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Every entry in the feed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `feed_type` (String) The output format, such as `SURICATA`, `MODSECURITY`, `AWS_WAF`, `CLOUDFLARE_WAF` or `SIGMA`.
- `manifest_url` (String) The published feed's `manifest.json`. Null until the feed is published.
- `public_base_url` (String) Where the published files are served from. Null until the feed is published.
- `published_at` (Number) When the feed was last published, in Unix milliseconds.
- `revoked_at` (Number) When the feed was revoked, in Unix milliseconds.
- `rule_count` (Number) How many entries the feed holds.
- `schema_version` (Number) The feed's file format version.
- `status` (String) `DRAFT`, `PUBLISHED` or `REVOKED`.
- `updated_at` (Number) When the feed was last changed, in Unix milliseconds.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (Number) When the entry was added, in Unix milliseconds.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the entry is left out of the published feed.
- `id` (Number) The entry's id within the feed.
- `matched_cve` (String) The vulnerability the rule was added for, when known.
- `rule_name` (String) The rule's name.
- `rule_source` (String) The rule's source, when known.
- `rule_table` (String) Where the rule comes from: `snort_rule`, `yara_rule`, `virtual_patch` or `countermeasure`.
- `rule_type` (String) The rule's format, such as `SURICATA` or `SIGMA`.
- `rule_uuid` (String) The rule's id in its table.
